name: morrisons.com
body: Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But next.js 16.2.3 has known flaws.
lesson: Check front-end library versions against a known-flaw list on every release, and upgrade the ones that are flagged.
summary: www.morrisons.com scores 70 out of 100 (C). 7 checks fail now, 21 are at risk, and 33 pass. Fix first: 17 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 17 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /more, /content/morrisons-now-same-day-grocery-delivery, /help and 12 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Next.js 16.2.3 has known flaws
fix.evidence: Next.js 16.2.3 (read from the page): 30 known flaws, the worst rated critical, such as CVE-2026-44575, CVE-2026-44573, CVE-2026-44572. Next.js: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution in Image Optimization API when AVIF files are used. Checked against the…

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 5 elements on /, for example .row-span-3.md\:row-span-2.bg-card:nth-child(1) > .aspect-video.group[aria-label=""] and .bg-card.rounded-xl.overflow-hidden:nth-child(2) > .aspect-video.group[aria-label=""]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

fix.title: 7 sitemap URLs point at another host or scheme
fix.evidence: In /sitemap.xml: my.morrisons.com (5), groceries.morrisons.com (1), www.morrisons.jobs (1). The sitemap should list only URLs on https://www.morrisons.com.
fix.fix: Regenerate the sitemap with the production https host.

fix.title: All touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 4 elements on /, for example .lg\:mb-20.mb-10:nth-child(3) > .lg\:mb-6.mb-4 > a and .lg\:mb-20.mb-10:nth-child(7) > .lg\:mb-6.mb-4 > a. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Make tap targets at least 24 by 24 px, or leave that much space around them.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 324 ms
Every page has a meta description
Structured data parses and carries the expected properties
